Coram : D.K. JAIN*, H.L. DATTU, J.S. KHEHAR
INCOME TAX ACT, 1961 A B c Chapter XIV-B - Scope of - Explained - ss. 158 BB, 158 BC and 158 BO read with ss. 132 and 139 -Detection of undisclosed income of assessee during search of another concern - Plea of assessee that since it had paid Advance 0 Tax, its income to be undisclosed - Held: Payment of Advance Tax, which is based upon estimated income, cannot tantamount to the disclosure of the total income, which must be declared in the return - Disclosure of total income by filing of return u/s 139 is mandatory even after E payment of Advance Tax by an
Decision Date : 14-01-2013 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2688/2006 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
